mapper.select: SELECT id FROM archive_record WHERE employee_id = #{employeeId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_object (object_key, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, storage_provider) VALUES (#{objectKey}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{storageProvider})
INSERT INTO archive_document (archive_record_id, document_type, title, status) VALUES (#{archiveRecordId}, #{documentType}, #{title}, 'ACTIVE')
INSERT INTO archive_version (document_id, version_no, file_object_id, status, created_by) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{versionNo}, #{fileObjectId}, #{status}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select:
SELECT v.id AS version_id, v.document_id, v.version_no, v.file_object_id, v.status AS version_status, v.created_by, v.created_at AS version_created_at, f.id AS file_id, f.object_key, f.original_name, f.content_type, f.size_bytes, f.sha256, f.storage_provider, f.created_at AS file_created_at FROM archive_version v JOIN file_object f ON f.id = v.file_object_id JOIN archive_document d ON d.id = v.document_id AND d.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN archive_record ar ON ar.id = d.archive_record_id AND ar.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN employee e ON e.id = ar.employee_id AND e.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE v.id = #{id}
AND 1 = 1 AND e.department_id = #{departmentId} AND e.id = #{employeeId} AND 1 = 0

AND 1 = 1 AND e.department_id = #{departmentId} AND e.id = #{employeeId} AND 1 = 0
